description: Born and raised in North Carolina by a single mother, Grant grew up in a family that had difficulties making ends meet. Recognizing that education was the best escape from poverty, Grant went on to graduate from UNC-Chapel Hill for both undergraduate and medical school. After 9/11, Grant answered the call to serve our nation as a military doctor, including three tours in the Middle East.
